translation: If one obtains free and easy movement of the viscera and bowels, it is also no harm; the effect is even more excellent. Afterwards, one may take it regularly, or additionally take Xiaopi Wan (消痞丸). If one feels the intestines and stomach are bound and stagnant, or if damp-heat is severe within with spontaneous diarrhea, remove the rhubarb and mirabilite (芒硝).
